title: Operator guide for claude on the subscription (first claude-config cloud run)
description: The smoke run of the claude config in the cloud (operator, 2026-10-07): a deliberately small epic whose workers run on claude via the subscription rung (sonnet implement, opus review/close-out). Deliverable: the operator documentation that v5t shipped without — how to add, list, rotate and remove subscriptions (CLAUDE_SUB_TOKEN_<LABEL> Worker secrets, made with claude setup-token), how the pool fails over (lease at job start, bench on a quota 429 until the unified reset, the retry leases another subscription, Workers AI when none is free), how an epic selects the claude config (config:claude label, --config, the [configs] default), and how to see the pool's state.
acceptance_criteria: [A1] docs/claude-sub-operator.md exists and covers: making a token, adding/rotating/removing a subscription with wrangler secret commands against the production config, label rules, failover behaviour, selecting the config per epic, and observing the pool — every claim checked against cloudflare/src/claude-sub.ts, cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts and internal/reconcile/runconfig_select.go. [A2] README.md links to it. [A3] make gate passes. [A4] The run's workers ran on claude via the subscription rung (the run's events show the claude-sub lease, not a step-down).
closed_reason: Landed: the epic PR #254 is merged into main as 1daafef50e0c (merged by ticfac run run_18eafdaa047544be9a196d913fb08a30); CI on main is green at 1daafef50e0c.
